title: Cubical multiplication roof notation and normalization
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative condensed ring on the coherent profinite site, $r\geq0$, $J$ a normalized comparison between generalized-section and discrete $\mathbf Z^r$ actions, $C$ a cubical model with the cell coproducts, boundary, translation and contraction of [lem-sfb-lattice-cubical-augmentation-evaluation], $K$ a finite subset-coordinate Koszul model [lem-sfb-discrete-lattice-koszul-resolution], and $B$ an equivariant unital $R$-algebra [lem-sfb-lattice-flat-twisted-chain-pairing]. Work in ordinary signed cochain tensors and derived localization [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Put $L=J(C.L)$, $X=tK(B)$ and $Z=B[0]$. A roof datum is a triple of chain maps $\varepsilon:L\to R[0]$, $\Delta:L\to L\otimes L$ and $E:X\otimes L\to Z$. Define its comparison $\delta=(1\otimes\Delta);\tau$, denominators $a=(1\otimes\varepsilon);\rho$, $b=((1\otimes\varepsilon);\rho)\otimes((1\otimes\varepsilon);\rho)$, and numerators $f=(\star\otimes1);E$, $g=(E\otimes E);m_B$, with the ambient associators and signed middle interchange. Its normalization predicate says: every vertex augments to $1$; the diagonal on a cell is $\sum_{A\subseteq I}\epsilon(A,I\setminus A)[v,A]\otimes[v+u_A,I\setminus A]$; evaluation on a Koszul coordinate $A$ of degree $p$ and a cell $[v,I]$ of degree $-p$ is $c_pT^v$ after the right unitor if $A=I$, and zero otherwise, where $c_p=(-1)^{p(p+1)/2}$; and both counits and the double augmentation identity hold. The tensor-representative predicate says that the three complexes $X\otimes X$, $(X\otimes X)\otimes L$, and $(X\otimes L)\otimes(X\otimes L)$ have acyclic total tensor with every acyclic complex, and that the canonical localization tensor comparison is invertible on every pair of these three complexes. These definitions abbreviate the existing constructions without any existence choice.
